content:
rachid: Quick spike: embeddings p99 rising for mixed small batches during peak. sample pattern: lots of 1-2 item requests (1536 dim) interleaved with occasional large 12k-d vectors.

sophie: are these hitting the same router pool? mixed-dim bursts can cause the splitter to flip behavior and add backpressure.

ben: thought: implement a backpressure coalescer that temporarily prioritizes tiny requests onto a low-overhead path while large vectors get scheduled separately. mustn't change billing semantics invisibly.

sre-oncall: telemetry we need: `embeds.coalescer.invocations`, `embeds.coalescer.small_route_rate`, `embeds.coalescer.unit_delta_pct`, `embeds.coalescer.requeues`. alert if unit_delta_pct > 12% sustained 15m.

rachid: router sketch: if (mixed_payload && small_frac > 0.6 && queue_len < 6) route smalls -> COALESCE_FAST; else normal. also emit `router_coalesce_reason` tag.

sophie: console UX: add "Coalescer" visibility: %coalesced, p50/95/99 for coalesced vs normal, and per-tenant unit delta. toggle to hide tenants w/ <2% coalesce.

ben: safety: require opt-in via SDK header `X-Embed-Coalesce: optin` for first rollout to avoid accidental billing shifts. default off.

sre-oncall: add `coalescer_rejects` counter when queue >=6 and we don't coalesce. useful to tune threshold.

ui-team-bot: feature-flag pipeline created: `embeds.coalescer_optin` -> canary 8% -> will push a canary snapshot into this channel.

sophie: action list: ben implement router gating + tags, rachid add trace spans for coalescer path, ui-team-bot mock console card, sre-oncall wire metrics/alerts. reconvene after canary snapshot. :thumbsup:
